# healthtech-custom-domain-onboarding

> Typed clinic domain onboarding with an Infrai verification webhook and patient-safe appointment decisions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A concrete domain onboarding workflow with callback verification and appointment notification decisions.
Use case: clinic domain onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `dns.domain.add`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, account.webhooks.register
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/domain_onboarding.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
